messages.subject: lavInspect("first.order") error
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to extract the gradient, and have been running into this error:

Error in t(Delta[[g]]) %*% B1 : non-conformable arguments

It should be reproducible from:
HS <- HolzingerSwineford1939
mod <- '
f =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9
'
fit <- cfa(mod,HS)
lavInspect(fit,"first.order")

Thanks,
Ross

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: lavInspect("first.order") error
parts:
On 03/22/2015 03:05 AM, Ross Jacobucci wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I am trying to extract the gradient, and have been running into this error:
>
> Error in t(Delta[[g]]) %*% B1 : non-conformable arguments

Yep. The problem is that (in 0.5-17) the code for the first.order
information matrix assumes that we have a meanstructure in place. We
check for this when you fit the model:

> fit <- sem(HS.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939, se="first.order")
Error in lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats =
lavsamplestats, :
se (first.order) requires meanstructure (for now)

but lavInspect() does not check for that...

The workaround (for now) is to refit using meanstructure = TRUE.

Yves.
